claim.statement: Anysphere's 22 July 2026 Cursor Router announcement says Auto analyzes each request and routes it to a model, offers Cost, Balance and Intelligence optimization modes, supports desktop, and allows administrator controls that can restrict modes and underlying models or hide the routed model.

source.title: Cursor Router
source.locator: Auto mode, Optimization modes and Admin controls

limitations: The routing announcement is a rolling service statement and is not versioned with the 3.14 desktop binary.
Auto is configuration-dependent and does not identify a stable model checkpoint, provider endpoint or per-request routing result.
unknowns: The selected model, provider, checkpoint, endpoint revision, reasoning mode and optimization mode are unknown.
Whether the routed model was visible and which organization restrictions applied are unknown.
